Description.message: Partially replace the URL of the currently open web page and open it in another tab. Please use it for switching domains. etc...

option_message_01.message: *From ver.1.20, the data save destination has been changed. Please make the settings again.

option_message_02.message: Please be assured that the old data will be deleted when the option screen is initially displayed.

option_message_03.message: An extension that replaces the URL of the currently open web page and opens it in an another tab. Please use it for switching domains, switching test environments and other.

option_message_10.message: Please check the Crome Web Store

option_message_12.message: As in the above sample, set the domain root such as 'production environment', 'staging environment', and 'local environment'.

option_message_13.message: When browsing a web page containing the set URL in Chrome, clicking on the extension tab () will display links for switching.

option_message_14.message: (1) If only two document roots are set, another tab will open directly.

option_message_15.message: (2) You can also right-click within the page to display the context menu.

option_message_16.message: (3) In addition, ctrl + Shift + Up (up arrow) opens the shortcut! Soberly convenient.

option_message_17.message: Open in the same tab (with exactly 2 URLs, switch instantly on click; OFF uses a new tab)

popup_message_01.message: This URL is out of scope. Add a project or URL on the options page.

popup_message_02.message: *From ver.1.20, the data save destination has been changed. Please make the settings again.

option_sync_description.message: Settings are synced across all devices signed into the same Google account.

option_import_confirm.message: This will overwrite your current settings. Continue?

option_sync_error.message: Could not sync settings. They may exceed the sync size limit.

option_export_unsaved.message: There are unsaved changes. Export the last saved settings? (Unsaved edits will not be included.)

omnibox_filter.message: Type to filter, or pick an environment below

omnibox_nomatch.message: No matching environment for this page

option_restore_confirm.message: Restore settings from backup? Your current settings will be overwritten.

option_empty_save_confirm.message: There are no projects. Saving now overwrites your settings with empty data. Continue?

option_filter_placeholder.message: Filter by project name or URL...

option_feature_01_body.message: Type "sw" in the address bar and press Space to see switch targets for the current page. Filter further by typing a keyword.

option_feature_02_body.message: Grab any project card and drag it to your preferred position. Keep your most-used projects at the top.

option_feature_03_body.message: Filter the project list by name or URL as you type. Stays fast no matter how many projects you have.

option_feature_04_body.message: Every URL row in the popup has a copy button — grab any target URL to your clipboard instantly.

option_feature_05_body.message: Back up your settings as a JSON file or share them with your team. Re-import in seconds on a new machine.

option_feature_06_body.message: Settings sync automatically via your Google account. The same setup is ready on every Chrome device you sign into.

option_feature_07_label.message: Toggle same-tab mode from the popup

option_feature_07_body.message: Flip between "same tab" and "new tab" directly from the popup footer — no need to open the options page.

option_feature_08_body.message: Assign a color to each URL in the options page and a colored dot appears before that URL in the popup. Tell dev, staging, and production apart at a glance.

popup_color_hint.message: Hard to tell apart? You can set a color for each project in the options page.

option_feature_09_body.message: Give each URL a display name like "prod env" on the options page, and the popup can show that label instead of the raw URL. Switch between label and URL view anytime with the buttons at the bottom of the popup.
